questions.question: 3x + 4y = −6 and 2y − x = −8. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 2y + 8. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = −3 and x = 2; check: 3(2) + 4(−3) = −6.

questions.question: 2x + 3y = 16 and 1y − x = −3. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 1y + 3. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = 2 and x = 5; check: 2(5) + 3(2) = 16.

questions.question: 4x + 1y = −13 and 2y − x = 10. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 2y - 10. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = 3 and x = −4; check: 4(−4) + 1(3) = −13.

questions.question: 5x + 2y = 28 and 3y − x = −9. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 3y + 9. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = −1 and x = 6; check: 5(6) + 2(−1) = 28.

questions.question: 3x + 2y = −16 and 1y − x = −3. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 1y + 3. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = −5 and x = −2; check: 3(−2) + 2(−5) = −16.

questions.question: 2x + 5y = 26 and 2y − x = 5. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 2y - 5. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = 4 and x = 3; check: 2(3) + 5(4) = 26.

questions.question: 3x + 4y = 13 and 1y − x = −9. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 1y + 9. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = −2 and x = 7; check: 3(7) + 4(−2) = 13.

questions.question: 4x + 3y = −18 and 2y − x = 10. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 2y - 10. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = 2 and x = −6; check: 4(−6) + 3(2) = −18.

questions.question: 5x + 1y = −1 and 2y − x = −13. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 2y + 13. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = −6 and x = 1; check: 5(1) + 1(−6) = −1.

questions.question: 2x + 3y = 23 and 1y − x = 1. What is the solution (x, y) to the system of equations above?
questions.explanation: From the second equation x = 1y - 1. Substituting into the first equation and solving gives y = 5 and x = 4; check: 2(4) + 3(5) = 23.
